About us

Hello, we are three generations spread across cities and countries, held together by Sunday phone calls and a very big table.

It started in 1958, when Samuel and Ruth married and planted a jacaranda by the gate of their first home. The tree is still there, and so is the habit of feeding whoever walks through the door.
